summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, which becomes essential when you train or fine-tune custom models, need reproducible experiments, governance, and production-grade serving. If you only need to call a pre-built model (e.g., GPT, Claude, or Gemini) via API, a full MLOps platform is usually overkill; these platforms earn their keep when you own the model, the data pipeline, or require infrastructure control. The current landscape is dominated by the three hyperscaler offerings (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) with Databricks rising fast via MLflow and Mosaic AI, followed by specialized AutoML and MLOps-focused tools.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per instance-hour for compute, storage, and endpoints; no upfront fees. Savings plans available.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams developing and deploying custom models with deep service integration and granular control.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go for underlying compute/storage; no additional platform surcharge. Reserved instances available.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI, and integration with Azure OpenAI.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
capabilities: Gemini and foundation model access (Model Garden)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per node-hour for training/prediction, plus charges for AutoML and generative AI usage.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting highly automated, state-of-the-art managed pipelines and tight access to Gemini foundation models.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing via DBUs (Databricks Units) on top of underlying cloud compute; tiered by workload.
platforms.best_for: Collaborative data science and heavy data engineering/ETL on a unified multi-cloud lakehouse with custom LLM training.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions billed through Databricks or hosting provider.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, framework-agnostic standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; subscription per-seat/usage for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: Research and ML teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking, visualization, and collaboration across any framework.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription / custom quote based on usage and deployment scope.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated model building and governance with minimal hand-coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and enterprise platform via commercial subscription.
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing automated ML with strong interpretability, plus an open-source path.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, code-first GPU compute for training and deploying models without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + Inference Endpoints + AutoTrain)
platforms.cloud: Cloud-agnostic (AWS, Azure, GCP via Inference Endpoints)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models; paid Inference Endpoints and AutoTrain billed by compute; enterprise plans available.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source foundation models who need easy fine-tuning, sharing, and managed deployment.
